metadata.source: CGWB (Central Ground Water Board, Ministry of Jal Shakti) via the National Water Data Portal, nwdp.nwic.gov.in -- dataset 'Ground Water Level (Manual - Quarterly), CGWB'
metadata.resolution: Station points (CGWB manual quarterly monitoring wells/piezometers), aggregated to district by joining each row's own 'District LGD Code' field against this project's own Survey-of-India district_lgd (see dashboard/data/boundaries/soi/districts_index.json) -- not a name match, so it does not inherit the AGMARKNET-style spelling-mismatch problem documented in scripts/fetch_mandi_prices.py.
metadata.unit: meters (depth to water level below ground level, 'mbgl' -- the NWDP dataset's own notes text says only 'GWL values in meter (m)'; the mbgl-below-ground convention is CGWB's own standard reporting convention for this series and was cross-checked for plausibility against known real MP readings, see scripts/16_fetch_groundwater.py header)
metadata.method: Real CSV rows only -- no interpolation, no carrying forward. Per district: latest reading = the row with the maximum parsed Data Acquisition Time; trend = a plain OLS slope (same 'indicative OLS trend on real history' style as forecast_2040.json) fit on every station-district's numeric quarterly series across both the 1991-2020 and 2021-2025 (and 2026-2030 where present) CSV slices, only when enough real points exist -- never a projection dressed as an observation.
metadata.data_quality: verified-official (real CGWB dataset, government portal, no login)
